meta.title: Multiple Scope of Work (SoW): refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Locate and attempt the Multiple Scope of Work action for a user without the Buyer role and observe whether Procol refuses it or omits it.
Repeat the Multiple Scope of Work check as a Buyer in the same tenant and observe whether it is available.
Sign in as the two specified role personas or verify the tenant's RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Locate and attempt the Multiple Scope of Work action for a user without the Buyer role and observe whether Procol refuses it or omits it.; Repeat the Multiple Scope of Work check as a Buyer in the same tenant and observe whether it is available.; Sign in as the two specified role personas or verify the tenant's RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and the Buyer user in the same Enterprise tenant, attempt Multiple Scope of Work for each, and report whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to these role-specific users or locate and execute the Multiple Scope of Work feature.
Confirm the session remains free of a page crash or server error after the manual role-specific check.
